nodes.name: Warden
nodes.description: The gateway to the Warden path.  + Self-sustain  + Tankiness

nodes.name: Taunt
nodes.description: 50% chance to force enemies within 5m to target you for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Origin
nodes.description: The heart of the tree. Every path begins here.

nodes.name: Thorns
nodes.description: +15% Dmg Reflection

nodes.name: Safeguard
nodes.description: A single hit cannot deal more than 35% of Max HP.

nodes.name: Mending
nodes.description: +10% Heal Taken

nodes.name: Anchor
nodes.description: +15% Knockback Reduction  +5% Res

nodes.name: Headbutt
nodes.description: Dash forward and headbutt an enemy.  80% chance to stun for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Affront
nodes.description: 25% chance to taunt attackers for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Back to the Wall
nodes.description: +15% Dmg Reduction while below 50% HP.

nodes.name: Iron Fist
nodes.description: +15% Knockback Power  +15% Knockback Reduction

nodes.name: Unshakable
nodes.description: The first time HP drops below 30%, applies continuous healing for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Protector's Oath
nodes.description: Gains defense for 8 seconds each time an allied monster is defeated.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.description: Increases defense for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Ground Slam
nodes.description: Slam the ground, hitting all enemies around you.  50% chance to slow for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Barricade
nodes.description: Raises a wall that blocks enemies.  The wall crumbles after 10 seconds, or sooner if destroyed.

nodes.name: Last Stand
nodes.description: For 6 seconds, your HP cannot drop below 1.

nodes.name: Braced
nodes.description: After 3 seconds without taking damage, +15% Damage Reduction until you are hit.

nodes.name: Punish
nodes.description: Enemies you taunted take damage equal to 20% of your Defense when they hit you.

nodes.name: Ironblood
nodes.description: While at least 3 enemies are within 4m, heal for 20% of the damage you take.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description: Recover 25% of your missing HP and remove one harmful effect.

nodes.name: Retribution
nodes.description: Throw your shield, hitting up to 2 enemies.  Damage is based on your Defense instead of your Attack.

nodes.name: Gladiator
nodes.description: The gateway to the Gladiator path.  + Damage  + Mobility

nodes.name: War Cry
nodes.description: A shout that knocks back nearby enemies.  30% chance to remove a buff.  20% chance to reduce attack for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Bloodlust
nodes.description: +2% Lifesteal

nodes.name: Keen Edge
nodes.description: +5% Crit Chance

nodes.name: Deep Wounds
nodes.description: +15% Crit Damage

nodes.name: Ovation
nodes.description: Each non-crit grants +2% Crit Chance (max 5 stacks), reset on crit.

nodes.name: Assault
nodes.description: Somersaults towards the enemy and strikes 1 enemy.  Damage increases with the speed you close in on the target.

nodes.name: Bloodletting
nodes.description: Crits heal you for 5% of damage dealt.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.description: Crits have a 20% chance to break the target's Defense for 5s.

nodes.name: Defiance
nodes.description: +10% Resistance. Resisting a debuff grants 3s of Speed.

nodes.name: Relentless
nodes.description: Each kill refunds 1s of every skill cooldown.

nodes.name: Berserker
nodes.description: Once per life, dropping below 35% HP grants +Attack for 8s.

nodes.name: Slash
nodes.description: Slashes 1 enemy in front of you and knocks it back.  75% chance to reduce defense for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Whirlwind
nodes.description: Spin in place, striking everything around you repeatedly.

nodes.name: Roll
nodes.description: Rolls forward and cannot be targeted for 1 second.  Stabs on the way out: +50% critical damage from behind.

nodes.name: Hook
nodes.description: Throws a hook at the first enemy in line and drags it to you.  If the target has 30% knockback resistance or more, you are thrown to it instead.  If it kills its target, the hook keeps going.

nodes.name: Pit Fighter
nodes.description: +4% Defense per nearby enemy (max 3).

nodes.name: Duelist
nodes.description: +20% damage while only one enemy is nearby.

nodes.name: First Blood
nodes.description: Deal 50% bonus damage to enemies at full health.

nodes.name: Frenzy
nodes.description: +Attack Speed for 6s.

nodes.name: Parry
nodes.description: Blocks all damage for 0.33 seconds.  A blocked blow deals no knockback and no harmful effect.  A successful parry resets this skill's cooldown and reduces all others by 1 second.

nodes.name: Enchanter
nodes.description: The gateway to the Enchanter path.  + Utility and debuffs  + Healing

nodes.name: Phantom Step
nodes.description: Dashes forward and hits enemies on the path.  Turns invisible for 2 seconds.  20% chance to blind the target for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Talisman
nodes.description: +10% Accuracy

nodes.name: Clairvoyance
nodes.description: Hitting an enemy grants +10% Accuracy per debuff it carries (max 5).

nodes.name: Catalyst
nodes.description: Receiving a debuff refunds 1s of every skill cooldown.

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.description: Buffs you receive last 25% longer (at least +1s).

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.description: Shields the 2 nearest allies for 10% of their max HP plus 50% of their Defense.  The shield wears off by 1% of what remains every 0.3 seconds.

nodes.name: Torment
nodes.description: +20% damage to stunned, rooted or frozen targets.

nodes.name: Mercy
nodes.description: An ally dropping below 15% HP gets a 3s regeneration (20s cooldown).

nodes.name: Harvest
nodes.description: 3% of the damage you deal heals the most wounded nearby ally.  Never heals you.

nodes.name: Premonition
nodes.description: Once per life, the killing blow leaves you at 1 HP.

nodes.name: Requiem
nodes.description: When an ally dies, allies in the area get 5s of every cooldown refunded.

nodes.name: Hexbolt
nodes.description: Fires a cursed bolt at 1 enemy.  Reduces attack for 3 seconds.  Reduces this skill's cooldown by 6 seconds if the target cannot be healed.

nodes.name: Blight
nodes.description: Fires 2 homing bolts.  80% chance to prevent healing for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Entangle
nodes.description: Raises a bramble under up to 2 nearby enemies.  80% chance to root them for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Cleanse
nodes.description: Removes 1 debuff from each nearby ally and from yourself.  Restores 5% of Max HP for each debuff removed.

nodes.name: Unravel
nodes.description: Each hit has a 5% chance to strip a buff from the target.

nodes.name: Paradox
nodes.description: Resisting a debuff has a 25% chance to send it back to its caster.

nodes.name: Guardian Angel
nodes.description: Every 20s, an ally that would die is saved and turns invincible for 2s.

nodes.name: Dark Lance
nodes.description: Slams a dark lance onto 1 enemy.  Removes 100 energy (50 on bosses).

nodes.name: Sacrifice
nodes.description: Spends 30% of Max HP to heal each nearby ally for that amount.  Prevents HP from dropping below 1 for 3 seconds.
